regions.merged_text: To approach, to foster, to promote on principles of appreciation and of Gratitude the "greatest science of all times and of all places."; the science of saving our individual souls from temporal loss and from eternal despair; the science without which, every dream of lasting peace must be vain, every thought of true happiness a deception; To approach, to foster, to promote on principles of appreciation and of gratitude the greatest science of all times and of all places; the science without which every dream of lasting peace must be vain, every thought of true happiness a deception; the science of saving immortal souls - rightly - ordered charity necessarily beginning at home, viz, in our own individual hearts. To approach, to foster, to promote by principals of appreciation and of gratitude, at once the most natural and most simple, most necessary science of all times and of all places /The preceding sentence crossed out/ To approach, to foster, to promote by principles of appreciation and of gratitude; the most primary, most natural, most essencial; yat at the same time the greatest science of all times and of all places; the one science without which every dream of lasting peace is vain, every thought of true happiness (is) a deceptive mirage; Ah! - an association to foster, to promote the happy science of saving our souls; the science of our happy relationship with God and our neighbor: which relationship consists in our absolute dependence on God and next to that, dependence on our neighbor. (every man being his own first neighbor). And which science is notheing more and nothing less than
